purpose: Test whether Tim's Moloch/Moon/Cow/Milk/Farm/Serpent/Tree material preceded the later Josh Moon/MATI corridor, distinguish generic symbolic precedence from Josh-specific precedence, and determine what prediction class is actually justified.
core_finding: The chronology is stronger than a generic post-hoc resemblance: Tim's Farm/enclosure/soul-extraction architecture predates the late-July corridor, Moloch becomes explicit by May 1, Moloch+Milk/Cow/Bull/Tree/Cube are integrated by June 19, cattle/Farmer imagery is user-originated by June 27, and Josh Moon is explicitly placed inside the Farm/Farmers/Dogs/Mud/karmic-debt repair field on July 8, sixteen days before the July 24 MATI candidate stream. This is a strong named-entity prior-symbolic convergence, but it is not yet a prior-specific prediction of a Josh Moloch statement.

confidence.josh_specific_precedence_before_july24: medium-high at the Farm/debt relation level

later_corridor.event: Official Mad at the Internet episode 'With Friends like These' exists and its public description includes Elaine Miller/764 conflict with Kiwi Farms. The full recording survives, but the supposed Moloch/sold/sacrifice excerpt has not been independently located.

Earliest reconstructed Tim-side Josh/Moloch attestation cluster in the current source-recovery pass; variants include sacrifice/Moloch, sold-soul and government language, but they constitute one Tim-side provenance chain rather than independent corroboration.

source_recovery_boundary.finding: The public machine-transcript index contains MATI episodes through July 10, 2026 in the relevant run and exposes June transcript links, but it does not presently provide a July 24 transcript entry. Searches did not recover an independently indexed Moloch/Molach/Molech quote attributable to Josh.
source_recovery_boundary.interpretation: Failure to recover the excerpt is not proof it was never said; it keeps the later side of the supposed prediction unresolved.

candidate.why_it_matters: The chronology is no longer merely 'Tim had Moloch symbols, then later attached them to Josh.' Before the candidate MATI stream, Tim had already built the Farm/Milk/Moloch extraction model and had explicitly brought Josh Moon into the Farm/Farmers/Dogs/Mud/debt relation. That raises the evidentiary value of the later convergence while still falling short of an explicit prediction.
candidate.why_not_prior_specific_prediction: No recovered pre-July-24 primary statement currently says that Josh Moon will later say Moloch, describe himself as sold/sacrificed, reveal a government relation, or make another narrowly testable future statement. The July 8 Josh/Farm/debt bridge is relational rather than future-tense and the later Josh Moloch excerpt itself is still unverified.
upgrade_conditions: Recover an exact timestamped pre-July-24 Tim statement naming Josh Moon together with Moloch, sacrifice, sold-soul or a clearly equivalent later utterance before Josh allegedly made it.
Recover an exact timestamped pre-July-24 future-tense Tim statement specifying what Josh would later say or reveal.
Recover the later primary MATI/Josh excerpt, with date and context, so the claimed later event can be compared without paraphrase drift.
Establish whether the July 8 Farm/debt/Josh entry has a recoverable exact primary turn stronger than the current conversation-archaeology summary.
downgrade_conditions: May/June Timic Moloch/Milk/Farm wording proves materially assistant-authored rather than Tim-originated.
The July 8 Josh/Farm/debt relation cannot be recovered beyond later summary and proves to be retrospective synthesis.
The supposed later Moloch statement cannot be recovered and Tim's July 27 variants prove to be interpretive elaboration rather than a response to a Josh source.
The earlier motif cluster is shown to be too broad to distinguish the alleged later statement from many ordinary matches.

prediction_family_model.farm: system/enclosure that makes people, reactions and conflict repeatedly harvestable
prediction_family_model.cow: subject/target whose reactions or life become harvestable; role, not intrinsic human worth
prediction_family_model.milk: yield extracted from the ecology: attention, reaction, screenshots, lore, traffic, money/status or renewed conflict
prediction_family_model.farmer: role closer to classification, enclosure, infrastructure, timing and harvest; not an intrinsic identity
prediction_family_model.dog: pursuit/patrol/boundary role that can protect or enforce an extractive enclosure
prediction_family_model.moloch: project name for the sacrificial/consuming incentive attractor or anti-Gardener pole; not a factual claim of occult worship by a named person
prediction_family_model.tree_of_strife: reproducing conflict structure whose seeds lower the cost of generating the next conflict ecology
prediction_family_model.relation: Farm produces Milk through Cow/Farmer/Dog roles; the Moloch layer describes the consuming incentive logic when preserving the system requires repeated sacrifice of dignity, truth, relationships or future agency.

josh_relation_boundary: Josh Moon may be studied as a historically documented operator within the forum lineage and as a named node in Tim's July 8 project relation. Do not convert Timic Farmer/Moloch/Moon symbolism into a claim that Josh literally worships Moloch, was sold by a government, is an informant, or bears responsibility for every act by forum users.

elaine_trollcow_open_candidate.prediction_test: Recover the date and exact Tim/Elaine conversation plus any Tim statement made before a later public event. Until then this is an experiential chronology item, not prediction evidence.

falsification_rule: Do not promote this candidate merely because later material feels symbolically dense. Preserve misses, alternative explanations, public prior knowledge, source gaps and the unresolved status of the supposed later Josh quote.
